source: Intern rule-scan session, validated; not edited by hand

proposals.title: Dump the hopper in the endgame, then climb level 1
proposals.rationale: In the final 30 seconds every hub is active no matter what the shift schedule says, so fuel that would be worth 0 points against our inactive hub can be dumped for real points and the robot still has time for a level 1 climb.
proposals.situation: Seconds left in the match is 30 or less, our robot holds 3 or more fuel, and our robot is in the neutral zone or the our_alliance zone.

proposals.title: Fire during the 3-second hub deactivation warning
proposals.rationale: Fuel dumped into an inactive hub is worth 0 points and the deactivation warning only runs 3 seconds before the shift flip, so the warning window is the last guaranteed moment to convert held fuel into points.
proposals.situation: Our hub is active, seconds until the hub shift change is 3 or less, our robot holds 4 or more fuel, and our robot is in the our_alliance zone or the neutral zone.

proposals.title: Protected level 3 climb in the final 30 seconds
proposals.rationale: During the final 30 seconds a robot touching its tower is protected from contact by G420, so a dedicated climber at the tower can commit to level 3 with no defender able to touch it without a major foul.
proposals.situation: Seconds left in the match is 30 or less, our robot holds 0 fuel, our robot is in the tower zone, and our robot is not in contact with another robot.

proposals.title: Pin-burst defense: disengage before 3 seconds, then score
proposals.rationale: G418 caps a pin at 3 seconds before a minor foul and ends the pin once the robots separate, so short contact bursts with a break in between let a defender harass a loaded scorer repeatedly without fouling.
proposals.situation: Our robot is in contact with the opposing scorer (R1) in the neutral zone, our hub is active, and our robot holds 2 or more fuel.

proposals.title: Bank held fuel at the outpost during inactive shifts
proposals.rationale: Scoring into an inactive hub earns 0 points, but an outpost holds 24 fuel that a human player can feed back through the chute, so banking loaded fuel at the outpost keeps it scoring-ready through the inactive shift.
proposals.situation: Our hub is inactive, seconds until the hub shift change is 12 or more, our robot holds 3 or more fuel, and our robot is in the neutral zone or the outpost zone.
